harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS share on node1 (/srv/nfs/shared) exported to node2, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, with shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) and dataops:dataops ownership, mode 2770, on both systems. Cross-node write consistency verified. Both nodes restarted one at a time (node1 then node2) with confirmed changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of NFS server/export and client mount with data intact.
actions_performed: Inspected both nodes: confirmed CentOS Stream 10, no dataops user, no nfs-utils installed, target dirs absent
Created dataops group/user (UID/GID 4500, no home, nologin shell) identically on node1 and node2
Installed nfs-utils on both nodes via dnf
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, set owner dataops:dataops, mode 2770 (drwxrws---)
Wrote /etc/exports on node1 restricting export to node2's IP (10.100.42.11) with rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash
Enabled and started rpcbind and nfs-server on node1; ran exportfs -rav to activate the export
Opened firewalld services nfs, rpc-bind, mountd on node1 and reloaded
Created /mnt/shared on node2, added fstab entry for the NFS mount with _netdev, mounted it
Verified showmount from node2 and bidirectional file creation (from_node1.txt, from_node2.txt) preserving dataops:dataops ownership on both nodes
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/data health baseline on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded to allow ack to return), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and uptime 0, verified nfs-server/rpcbind active, export present, and files intact
Verified node2's existing mount survived node1's reboot (hard mount) with data intact
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and uptime 0
Verified /mnt/shared auto-remounted via fstab after node2 reboot with correct ownership/mode and existing files intact
Performed a post-restart write test from node2 to confirm the share remains fully functional

evidence.requirement: dataops user/group UID/GID 4500 created identically on node1 and node2
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) on both nodes

evidence.requirement: Shared directory /srv/nfs/shared owned dataops:dataops mode 2770 on node1
evidence.summary: ls -ld shows drwxrws---. dataops dataops

evidence.requirement: NFS export configured and active on node1, scoped to node2
evidence.summary: /etc/exports content, nfs-server/rpcbind active, exportfs -v shows export to 10.100.42.11, firewalld opened for nfs/rpc-bind/mountd

evidence.requirement: node2 mounts the share at /mnt/shared with correct ownership/mode visible
evidence.summary: showmount confirms export reachable, fstab entry added, mount succeeds and shows drwxrws--- dataops dataops via NFS

evidence.requirement: Consistent ownership for files created from either system
evidence.summary: File created as dataops from node2 (from_node2.txt) and from node1 (from_node1.txt) both show dataops:dataops ownership on both sides

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 0581c914-..., nfs-server/rpcbind active, export present, files present pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned and node changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; node1 unreachable mid-reboot; post-reboot boot_id is 4b54d47d-... (changed) with uptime 0 min

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered NFS server/export and data post-restart
evidence.summary: nfs-server/rpcbind active again, export present, both files intact on node1; node2's existing mount also confirmed intact post node1-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 8f258838-... and confirmed mount/data healthy on node2 before reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returned and node changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node2 unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id is d0fa4a90-... (changed from 8f258838-...) with uptime 0 min

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: recovered mount, data, and ownership post-restart
evidence.summary: NFS mount auto-recovered via fstab (_netdev) post-reboot with correct dataops:dataops ownership/mode and existing files intact; post-restart write test succeeded
